summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for new permissions model and restricted-user routing/UI controls. Backend permission normalization tests passed. Core UI permission gates passed (sidebar hiding, route redirect, journal restrictions, users permissions grid, operations new-block removal). Two UI checks remained inconclusive due missing live rows in preview data.

integration_issues.issue: No operation cards were rendered for the seeded restricted session during automation, so card-level edit/delete/confirm button hiding could not be deterministically verified on actual rows.

integration_issues.flow: Smart POS recent entries amount masking
integration_issues.issue: Recent entries list was empty in this preview dataset/session, so assertion of amount masking in existing rows was inconclusive.

action_items: Run one deterministic seed/setup with at least one recent journal entry to finalize Smart POS 'no amount in recent entries' assertion.
Provide/seed at least one visible operations card for restricted operations-view role to finalize card action-visibility assertions on real rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Operations.jsx and JournalEntries.jsx are very large files (>700 lines), increasing regression risk for permission-gating changes and making targeted maintenance/testing harder.
Auth playbook file /app/auth_testing.md is missing in workspace; optional auth playbook checks (bcrypt/cookie/CORS/lockout/seed_admin) were not executable from provided guidance file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with seeded localStorage/cookie sessions: unauthorized /operations redirected away, sidebar fully hides unauthorized operations/archive, /accounting/journal-entries accessible with journal_entries.view only, and journal controls hide when create/edit/delete/pos are false. UsersManagement modal exposes required module/action checkboxes (dashboard/operations/journal_entries/archive + POS/settle/edit/delete). Operations page new-operation block was not visible in admin validation. Remaining gaps are data-availability driven (no operation cards for restricted row-level action check, no POS recent rows for amount-masking verification).
rca of the issue: No deterministic functional defect was reproduced in implemented permission/routing/UI removals. Remaining unresolved points are test-data gaps in preview state (empty operations/recent entries for target assertions), not confirmed code regressions.
